summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing three new loan facility agreements totaling $190 million. The facilities finance the acquisition of two Suezmax newbuildings ($90M) and the purchase-back of two vessels from sale-leaseback arrangements ($50M each). Terms include Term SOFR plus 120-130 bps, 7-9 year maturities, quarterly installments, balloon payments, and vessel mortgages. These are routine debt financings, not a special situation. The filing is an ordinary update on corporate financing activities with no change of control, shareholder vote, or strategic event.
